name: Denisovan

taxonomic_status.classification: Denisovan (informal name; no Linnaean binomial formally and uncontestedly established at time of writing)
alternative_classifications: Identified primarily via ancient DNA rather than a type fossil in the traditional sense — see claim_denisovan_genome_before_morphology

notes: Type site is Denisova Cave, Siberia. The Xiahe mandible (Tibetan Plateau, ≥160,000 years) is the first physical evidence outside the type site — see claim_xiahe_mandible.
